common.sponsored_body: 接收来自无障碍和开发者社区企业的广告。尊重您的隐私，无追踪、无画像、无算法。
onboarding.heading: 欢迎使用 A11yFred
onboarding.welcome_body: en: Your AI-second helper for manual accessibility auditing and reporting.
onboarding.confirm_body: 您尚未完成引导tour。现在关闭并跳过剩余内容？
onboarding.slide_1_body: en: Describe what you observed: a component name, symptom, or WCAG success criterion. Use the Platform and WCAG Level filters to narrow the corpus. Use Narrow Results to filter within what is already showing. Results are sorted by relevance, then by severity.
onboarding.slide_2_body: en: Use Rank Up/Down to rank results by importance. Star a entry to always show it first. Pin a entry to keep it at the top across all searches.
onboarding.slide_3_body: en: Open a entry to see its title, WCAG criterion, description, and suggested fix. Add a location prefix to the description (e.g. 'Global:'). Use AI Assist to revise any field using your notes, then copy fields individually or use Copy All to grab everything at once.

help.take_tour_description: 重播引导教程，重新了解 A11yFred 的使用方式。
help.step_1_body: 结果会随您输入实时显示。使用设置中的平台筛选器选择 Web 或 Native App 的检测结果（大多数以 Web 为主）。使用 +term 要求包含某个词，使用 -term 排除某个词（例如：keyboard +screen reader -wcag2.2）。
help.step_2_body: en: Each result has Rank Up and Rank Down buttons to change how it ranks. Star a result to make it always appear first. Pin any result to keep it at the top across all searches.
help.step_3_body: 选择与您观察结果最匹配的发现。结果首先按相关性排序，然后按严重程度排序。
help.step_4_body: en: Add a location prefix to the description (e.g. 'Global:' or 'Cart:'). If AI Assist is on, add your notes to the Revision Notes field and AI will rewrite the entry to match your context.
help.step_5_body: en: Copy the description and suggested fix into your spreadsheet or report. Use Copy All to grab both fields at once.
help.shortcuts_note: 快捷键仅在焦点位于结果列表时有效。使用它们可以快速导航并对发现的问题进行评级，而无需离开列表。
help.shortcut_u: U = 取消归档当前结果
help.shortcut_rank_up: Shift + ↑ = 提升当前结果排名
help.shortcut_rank_down: Shift + ↓ = 降低当前结果排名
about.what_body: 个人无障碍审核写作助手。在 WCAG 对齐的缺陷描述库中搜索，选择与您发现相符的条目，自定义后直接复制到审核报告。
about.what_body_2_prefix: 几乎每个网站都会出现相同的问题。此工具可确保您在报告中对问题的描述保持一致，让您无需每次从头开始撰写。该库基于真实的审计工作构建，并借助 AI 进行了优化，以实现语言简洁、前后一致、准确可靠，并针对以下内容进行了事实核查：
about.what_wcag: Coverage extends up to WCAG 2.2 (Level A and AA) across both web and native app contexts.
about.feature_ai_body: 用简短备注优化任何缺陷描述。您的 API 密钥、AI 提供商 — 从不存储于服务器端。
about.feature_agentic_body: en: If you use Claude (Anthropic), you can also enable Match Existing Style. The AI will search past revision examples to match the tone and depth you have already established, not just rewrite the current entry in isolation.
about.feature_languages_body: 界面支持 50 多种语言，包括 RTL。在设置中切换。
about.feature_pinning_body: Pin any finding to keep it at the top across all searches and views. Use the priority arrows to rank others, star to float a finding to the very top, or archive to remove it from view.
about.feature_a11y_body: 按 WCAG 2.2 构建：焦点管理、实时区域、键盘导航、减少动效支持和高对比度标记。
about.sources_body: Entries are written in plain language, near-duplicates are consolidated, and each is aligned to a specific WCAG success criterion. Sources consulted include:

settings.privacy_body_1: API密钥本地存储在浏览器（localStorage）中，仅发送至AI提供商的API——从不发送至任何中间服务器。您可以随时通过删除密钥并保存，或清除浏览器站点数据来清除它们。
settings.privacy_body_2: 此应用在localStorage中存储六项内容：主题偏好、语言偏好、平台筛选（Web/原生）、实时搜索设置、活跃AI提供商和API密钥。不存储或传输其他数据。
